notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hey Brewmancers! I've concocted a fresh patch with some key fixes, tweaks, and magical touch-ups based on your feedback from the demo. Here's what's new in the cauldron:

[h1]🔧 Fixes & Improvements[/h1]

[h2]🧪 Fixed Potion Duplication Glitch[/h2]
No more endless brews from thin air! This pesky bug has been sealed with a properly.

[h2]🫧 Cauldron Disappearing Bug Fixed[/h2]
Rue's cauldron will no longer vanish into the void after brewing for some customers.

[h2]🎥 Camera Movement Modified[/h2]
Adjusted camera behavior for smoother movement and less disorientation while managing your potion shop.

[h1]🌟 Gameplay Changes[/h1]

[h2]🧱 First Chapter Update: Added Walls[/h2]
You’ll now see proper walls in Chapter 1. Feels like an actual shop now, right?

[h2]⭐ Rating System Overhaul[/h2]
Customer ratings now better reflect your performance and choices. No more harsh 1-stars for minor slip-ups, but no more generous S Ranks! (Outside the tutorial levels)

[h1]💫 Minor Touches[/h1]

Various tiny polish updates across UI, sound, and visual feedback to enhance your brewing experience. Think of it as a little sprinkle of fairy dust.

Thanks as always for playing Potion in Motion! Your support means the world (and beyond) to me. Stay tuned for more updates, and keep those potions bubbling! 💚
